meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (图文) with multiple images. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or image-text to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你的指示把内容发布到微信公众号:支持文章(接受 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本)和图文(配多张图)。它检查配置、转换格式、生成标题摘要,最后把草稿存进公众号后台。
howto.when: 当你说出“发布公众号”“post to wechat”“微信公众号”等词,或要求发图文/文章时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 发到我的公众号。
say.note: 它会先检查 Markdown 转换技能是否可用。

say.text: 用 API 把这篇 HTML 文章发布成草稿,标题叫《AI 入门》。
say.note: 需要先配置好公众号 API 凭据。

say.text: 发布一篇图文,用这几张图片和这段文字。
say.note: 图文最多支持 9 张图片。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude can publish to WeChat Official Account: articles (from HTML, Markdown, or text) and image-text posts with multiple images. It checks config, converts formats, generates metadata, and saves a draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “发布公众号”, “post to wechat”, “微信公众号”, etc., or ask for an image-text/article post.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown to my WeChat Official Account.
say_en.note: It will look for the Markdown conversion skill.

say_en.text: Publish this HTML as a draft via API, title 'AI Basics'.
say_en.note: API credentials must be set up first.

say_en.text: Post an image-text with these images and this text.
say_en.note: Image-text posts support up to 9 images.
